overall: Strong draft: the checker passes 234/234 items, all 72 pool tokens are covered, and the 4 exclusive calls (Courses, fairway, golfers, putt) are reasonable. Facts are accurate and distractors are well matched. Most items use clearly non-golf senses (military bunkers, badminton birdie, disability handicap, VW Golf, NATO alphabet, Montgolfier, McIlhenny). Three items dropped: the only 'icap' item, where the token is redundant because 'with no extra stones' already says it; the Ayrshire Firth of Clyde item (obscure, and golf fans know the coastal Open venues); and the golfer's-elbow side-of-elbow item (golf fans have an edge). Minor style points that don't warrant a drop: the three 'golf' items are all about Montgolfier, the NATO-alphabet angle repeats across the Golf tokens, and in the Augusta/Livia item the answer 'Augustus' echoes the token.
